'''Vaenrood''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TDC" /> located within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Vaenrood system/Legends|same name]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The world was also positioned inside the wedge-shaped region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]].<ref name="Region" /> Vaenrood was classed as terrestrial with at least one [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] area.<ref name="TDC" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]<ref name="TDC" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Battle of Vaenrood]] is set several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]], which the ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' dates to four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].</ref> Vaenrood was the site of a [[Battle of Vaenrood|battle]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Empire's forces included [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] units emplaced in Vaenrood's mountains, while the New Republic deployed [[New Republic Army|ground forces]] with air support provided by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="TDC" />

During the battle, an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Darryn Thyte]] was hit by artillery fire causing the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to crash. Thyte survived the impact but suffered the loss of most of his right [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] canopy buckled and snapped, shearing through the limb. [[Medic/Legends|Medics]] were able to replace Thyte's arm with a clunky [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthesis, which was the best available at the time.<ref name="TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaenrood was first mentioned in the short story "[[The Saga Begins]]" by [[Timothy Zahn]], published in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="TSB">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> Vaenrood is further elaborated on in Lieutenant Darren Thyte's character biography also published with the sourcebook.<ref name="TDC" />
